title: Automated DNA Extraction from Sediment Samples and Filter Membranes Using Magnetic Beads
author: Qianyue Ji

steps.title: Weigh sediment or cut filter
steps.instruction: Use 1 g of each sediment sample or cut one half of each filter membrane into small pieces.

steps.title: Centrifuge sediment samples
steps.instruction: Place sediment samples in 96‑well deep‑well plates (model 3960, Corning), centrifuge at 12 000 rpm, °C, for 00:05:00 (5 min), then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare bead‑mix reagent
steps.instruction: For each reaction, combine 20 µL Magnetic Beads‑T with 300 µL PFB‑M and mix thoroughly to obtain a 320 µL bead‑mix solution.

steps.title: Label and load plates
steps.instruction: Retrieve five U‑bottom deep‑well plates (MGI, catalog 1000004644) and label them respectively as “PFBM + Magnetic beads‑T”, “PW1‑M”, “PW2”, and “PB”. Add reagents to each plate as follows: (1) to the “PFBM + Magnetic beads‑T” plate add 320 µL of the bead‑mix solution and 240 µL of the sample; (2) to the “PW1‑M” plate add 400 µL PW1‑M; (3) to the “PW2” plate add 800 µL PW2; (4) to the “PB” plate add 120 µL PB.

substeps.instruction: Label plates as “PFBM + Magnetic beads‑T”, “PW1‑M”, “PW2”, and “PB”.
Add 320 µL bead‑mix + 240 µL sample to the “PFBM + Magnetic beads‑T” plate.
Add 400 µL PW1‑M to the “PW1‑M” plate.
Add 800 µL PW2 to the “PW2” plate.
Add 120 µL PB to the “PB” plate.

steps.title: Load script and consumables
steps.instruction: On the extraction instrument, select the DNA extraction script supplied by the vendor. Follow the on‑screen prompts to place the labeled deep‑well plates, samples, and reagents in the indicated positions, confirm the placement, and close the door.

steps.title: Run extraction
steps.instruction: Click “Run” to start the automated DNA extraction workflow.

steps.title: Store extracted DNA
steps.instruction: After the run completes, collect the extracted DNA and store it at –20 °C.
